name: video-walkthrough
description: Narrated walkthrough videos of a running web app: ElevenLabs voiceover, Playwright captures paced to the voice, HTML cards, ffmpeg assembly.

interface.shortDescription: Narrated walkthrough videos of a running web app, end to end
interface.longDescription: Writes a per-scene voice script for the audience, generates the voiceover with ElevenLabs, films each scene with Playwright paced to the narration, renders title, lower-third, code and closing cards from HTML, and assembles the cut with ffmpeg. Two cuts from one shoot; re-shoot one scene with one command.
defaultPrompt: Make a three minute admin walkthrough of the app at http://localhost:5678 for the customer's platform team.
Re-cut the existing walkthrough as a 90 second customer overview using the same captures.
